harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «تكاد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the fāʿil (agent) of {تَفُورُ}; «كل» is an adverb meaning "whenever", attached to (mutaʿalliq) «سألهم», and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e.: its keepers asked them at every time of throwing; the clause «سألهم» is resumptive; the clause «ألقي» is the ṣila of the relative particle (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī); and the clause «ألم يأتكم نذير» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the asking.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The clause «فكذَّبنا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «جاءنا»; «شيء» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «نزل», and «من» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause «إن أنتم إلا في ضلال» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and «إن» is negative.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: (لو كنا نسمع أو نعقل) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The conditional clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «فاعترفوا» is resumptive; his words «فسحقا»: the fāʾ is resumptive; [«سحقا» is a] mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and the clause (أسحقهم الله) is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «بالغيب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «يخشون», and the clause «لهم مغفرة» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن».

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «وأسِرُّوا» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «بذات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «ألا»: the hamza is for interrogation and «لا» is negative; the clause «وهو اللطيف» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause, and «والخبير» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «ذلولا» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «فامشوا» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «جعل»; and the clause «وإليه النشور» is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) «جعل».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «مَنْ» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يخسف» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «مَنْ»; the fāʾ in «فإذا» is a conjunction; «إذا» is of surprise (fujāʾiyya); and the clause «فإذا هي تمور» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «يخسف».

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: «أم» is the disjunctive [one] (al-munqaṭiʿa); the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يرسل» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «مَن»; the fāʾ connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied (muqaddar) condition, i.e.: if this comes to you, you will know; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «نذير»; the yāʾ of the first person was omitted from «نذير» for lightness; and the clause «كيف نذير» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of knowing, suspended by the interrogative.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «ولقد كذَّب» is resumptive; the fāʾ in «فكيف» is a conjunction, and the clause «فكيف كان نكير» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «كذَّب»; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, the khabar (predicate) of «كان»; «نكير» is the noun of kāna, nominative (marfūʿ) with the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ that was omitted for lightness.

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «أولم يروا» is resumptive; «فوقهم» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «الطير»; «صافَّات» is a second ḥāl; the clause «ويقبضن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the single-word ḥāl «صافات», in the manner of conjoining a clause to a single word; the clause «ما يمسكهنَّ إلا الرحمن» is a ḥāl from the pronoun in «يقبضن», i.e.: not held except by the Most Merciful; the clause «إنه بصير» is resumptive; the preposition and its genitive noun «بكل» is attached to «بصير».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: «أم» is the disjunctive [one] (al-munqaṭiʿa); «مَنْ» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «هذا» is its khabar (predicate); «الذي» is a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative; the clause «ينصركم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «جند»; the preposition and its genitive noun «من دون» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «ينصركم»; the clause «إن الكافرون إلا في غرور» is resumptive; «إنْ» is negative; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: «أم» is the disjunctive [one] (al-munqaṭiʿa); «من هذا» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the relative noun is a badal (substitute); the clause «إن أمسك» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it; the clause «لجُّوا» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The fāʾ is resumptive; «مَنْ» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is «أهدى»; the preposition and its genitive noun «على وجهه» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مكبا», the ḥāl (circumstantial); «أم» is the connected [one] (muttaṣila), a conjunction; «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first relative noun; «سويا» is a ḥāl; the preposition and its genitive noun «على صراط» is attached to «يمشي».

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «جعل», and «جعل» here means "created"; «قليلا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is redundant (zāʾida); the clause «تشكرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The preposition and its genitive noun «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ذرأكم», and the clause «تحشرون» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila (relative clause) «ذرأكم».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: The clause «ويقولون» is resumptive; «متى» is an interrogative noun, an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «هذا»; «الوعد» is a badal (substitute); the clause «إن كنتم صادقين» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The clause «وإنما أنا نذير» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إنما العلم عند الله».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «فلما رَأَوه» is resumptive; «لما» is a particle of necessity-upon-necessity [i.e. "when … then"]; «زلفة» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the hāʾ in «رأوه»; the clause «وقيل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «سيئت», and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of «قيل» is a pronoun referring to its maṣdar (verbal noun). The preposition and its genitive noun «به» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تدَّعون».

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The two objects of «أرأيتم» are implied (muqaddar): the first is "شأنكم" (your affair), and the second is an implied interrogative clause indicated by the resumptive clause «فمن يجير», the implied form being: have you considered your affair, if Allah destroys me, who will rescue us from His punishment? The conditional clause is parenthetical between the two objects, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what follows indicating it; «مَنْ» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the yāʾ; «معي» is an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause); the clause «فمن يجير» is resumptive, and the clause «يجير» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «من».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The clause «آمنَّا» is a second khabar (predicate) of the pronoun «هو»; the clause «فستعلمون» is resumptive; «من» is a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the ṣila (relative clause) is nominal.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: The two objects of «أرأيتم» are implied (muqaddar): the first is "شأنكم" (your affair), and the second is an interrogative clause indicated by the resumptive clause «من يأتيكم», as preceded in verse (28); the conditional clause is parenthetical.

mekki-muskil:3-3.t: His saying, Exalted is He, طباقا: a naʿt (adjective) of سبع, and it is the plural of طبقة, like رحبة and رحاب; it is also said: the plural of طَبَق, like جبل and جبال.

mekki-muskil:4-4.t:
His saying كرتين: accusative because it is in the position of the maṣdar (verbal noun), as if He said "so return the sight twice" (فارجع البصر رجعتين).
His saying خاسئا: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of البصر; likewise وهو حسير is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate) in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl of البصر.

mekki-muskil:8-8.t: His saying كلما ألقِي: كلما is accusative by ألقي as an adverb.

mekki-muskil:11-11.t:
His saying فَاعْتَرفُوا بذنبهم: الذنب was put in the singular, while the report is about a group, only because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) that applies to the few and the many.
His saying فسحقا: accusative by an implied verb, i.e. "Allah has imposed on them remoteness" (ألزمهم الله سحقا). It is also said that it is a maṣdar made a substitute for uttering the verb; this is the view of Sībawayh. The nominative is permissible in ordinary speech as a mubtadaʾ (subject).

mekki-muskil:14-14.t:
His saying أَلا يعلم من خلق: من is in the position of the nominative by يعلم, and the object is omitted; its implied form is "does not the Creator know His creation?" (ألا يعلم الخالق خلقه). This indicates that what the creatures conceal of their speech and what they say openly is all of Allah's creation, because He, Exalted is He, said وأسروا قولكم أو اجهروا به إنه عليم بذات الصدور ألا يعلم — the Creator — His creation; so all of it is Allah's creation.
Some of the people of deviation said that من is in the position of the accusative, a name for those who conceal and those who speak openly, in order to take the speech out of its generality and to deny general creation to Allah, exalted be His mention. Had it been as he claimed, He would have said ألا يعلم ما خلق, because what preceded was only the mention of what the breasts conceal, so it is in the position of ما. And had ما come in the place of من, there would also be in it a clear statement of generality: that Allah is the Creator of everything of the creatures' sayings, whether they concealed them or made them manifest, whether good or evil. His saying, Exalted is He, إنه عليم بذات الصدور strengthens that; He did not say "knowing of those who conceal and those who speak openly"; and ما would be in the position of the accusative. The verse only leaves this generality if you make من, in the position of the accusative, a name for the people addressed before this verse; and His saying بذات الصدور prevents that.

mekki-muskil:16-16.t: His saying أَن يخسف and وَأَن يُرْسل: أن in both is in the position of the accusative as a badal (substitute) of من, and it is a badal of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl). Al-Naḥḥās said أن is an object, and did not mention the badal; its justification is what I have mentioned to you.

mekki-muskil:19-19.t:
His saying صافات: a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الطير; likewise ويقبضن.
His saying أَفَمَن يمشي: a mubtadaʾ (subject); مكبا is a ḥāl of it, and أهدى is its khabar (predicate).

mekki-muskil:23-23.t: His saying وَجعل لكم السّمع: السمع was put in the singular only because it is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun), and then [the faculty] was named by it.

mekki-muskil:25-25.t: His saying مَتى هَذَا الْوَعْد: هذا is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and الوعد its naʿt (adjective), and متى is in the position of the nominative, the khabar (predicate) of هذا, and in it there is a nominative pronoun referring back to هذا. It is also said that هذا is nominative by the [implied] "being settled" (al-istiqrār), and متى is an adverb in the position of the accusative, so there is no pronoun in it.

mekki-muskil:27-27.t: His saying تدعون: it is تفتعلون from الدعاء (calling), and its origin is تدتعيون; then the تاء was assimilated into the دال, by assimilation of the second into the first, because the second is weaker than the first. The basic rule of assimilation is that the weaker is assimilated into the stronger, so that it gains strength from the assimilation; the دال is voiced (majhūr) and the تاء voiceless (mahmūs), and the voiced is stronger than the voiceless; therefore the second was assimilated into the first, so that the pronunciation becomes a doubled voiced letter, which is better than its becoming a voiceless letter.

mekki-muskil:30-30.t:
His saying فَمن يأتيكم: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and the فاء is the apodosis of the condition.
His saying بِمَاء معِين: معين may be the pattern فعيل from مَعَن الماء, when water is abundant; and it may be the pattern مفعول from العين (the eye), its origin being معيون. Then it underwent weak-letter change: the yāʾ was made quiescent for lightness and was omitted because it was quiescent and the wāw after it was quiescent; then the wāw was changed to a yāʾ because the عين before it had a kasra. It is also said, rather, that the wāw was omitted because it was quiescent and the yāʾ before it was quiescent. On this view its implied form is "who would bring you water that is seen with the eye?" [Translator's note: the edition prints «بَاء» where ياء (yāʾ) is meant.]

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿تبارك﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa.
﴿الذي﴾: the fāʿil (agent); the clause «تبارك» is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿بيده﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الملك﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿بيده الملك﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿على كل شيء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قدير﴾; ﴿كل﴾ is a muḍāf, and ﴿شيء﴾ is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the genitive (majrūr).
﴿قدير﴾: the khabar of «هو»; the clause ﴿هو على كل شيء قدير﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a badal (substitute) from the first relative noun, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ); or the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: «هو الذي» (He is the One who); or accusative (manṣūb) by way of praise (ʿalā al-madḥ).
﴿خلق﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو» (he).
﴿الموت﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the accusative.
﴿والحياة﴾: conjoined to «الموت», in the accusative; the clause ﴿خلق الموت والحياة﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿ليبلوكم﴾: the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); «يبلو» is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām; the fāʿil is latent, its implied form being «هو»; the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يبلوكم﴾ is made genitive (majrūr) by the lām of reason, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) «خلق».
﴿أيكم﴾: a mubtadaʾ.
﴿أحسن﴾: the khabar.
﴿عملا﴾: a tamyīz (specification); the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as the second object of «يبلوكم».
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or a conjunction, and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ.
﴿العزيز﴾: a first khabar.
﴿الغفور﴾: a second khabar; the clause is either in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «خلق», or conjoined to the clause ﴿خلق﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿الذي﴾: a second badal (substitute) from the relative noun, or from «العزيز الغفور», or a naʿt (adjective) of them both; or in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: «هو الذي» (He is the One who); or accusative (manṣūb) by way of praise (ʿalā al-madḥ).
﴿خلق﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa; its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو» (he). The clause ﴿خلق﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿سبع﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), made accusative by the fatḥa, and it is a muḍāf.
﴿سماوات﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the genitive (majrūr).
﴿طباقا﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿سبع﴾, made accusative by the fatḥa; or on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, the implied form being: «ذات طباق» (possessing layers); or a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «سماوات»; or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: «طوبقت طباقًا» (they were layered in layers), the clause ﴿طوبقت طباقا﴾ then being in the position of a naʿt.
﴿ما ترى﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position; ﴿ما﴾ is negating, and ﴿ترى﴾ is an imperfect verb with a latent fāʿil.
﴿في خلق الرحمن﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from ﴿تفاوت﴾.
﴿من تفاوت﴾: ﴿من﴾ is a redundant (ṣila) particle, and ﴿تفاوت﴾ is genitive in form and accusative in position, as the object of «ترى».
﴿فارجع﴾: the fāʾ is linking, for giving the reason; «ارجع» is an imperative verb, and its fāʿil is necessarily latent.
﴿البصر﴾: a mafʿūl bihi, in the accusative.
﴿هل﴾: an interrogative particle, indeclinable on sukūn, with no grammatical position.
﴿ترى﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative.
﴿من﴾: a redundant (ṣila) preposition.
﴿فطور﴾: genitive in form and accusative in position, as a mafʿūl bihi; the interrogative clause is in the place of an accusative by an omitted verb that is suspended (muʿallaq) [from governing] by the interrogative, i.e.: «انظر هل ترى من فطور؟» (look: do you see any rift?).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ثم﴾: a conjunction.
﴿ارجع﴾: an imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is necessarily latent (mustatir).
﴿البصر﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the accusative; the clause ﴿ارجع﴾ is in the position of a jussive (majzūm), because it is conjoined to ﴿ارجع﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source.]».
﴿كرتين﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is its number; it is made accusative by the yāʾ because it is a dual, and it is a dual by which multiplicity is meant.
﴿ينقلب﴾: an imperfect verb in the jussive, because it occurs as the answer to the request (ṭalab).
﴿إليك﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينقلب﴾.
﴿البصر﴾: the fāʿil, in the nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿خاسئا﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «البصر».
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿حسير﴾: the khabar (predicate); the clause is a ḥāl from «البصر», or from the pronoun latent in the ḥāl before it, so that it is an overlapping ḥāl (ḥāl mutadākhila).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the lām is in answer to the omitted oath; and «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq).
﴿زينا﴾: ﴿زين﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿زينا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath; and the implied clause of the oath is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿السماء﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), in the accusative.
﴿الدنيا﴾: a naʿt (adjective).
﴿بمصابيح﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, [the noun] made genitive by the fatḥa because it is a diptote, coming as it does on the pattern of the furthest plurals (ṣīghat muntahā al-jumūʿ); the two are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿زينا﴾.
﴿وجعلناها﴾: the wāw conjoins to ﴿زينا﴾; ﴿جعل﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn; ﴿نا﴾ is the fāʿil; ﴿ها﴾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿جعلناها﴾ is conjoined to ﴿زينا﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿رجوما﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi of «جعل».
﴿للشياطين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, [the noun] made genitive by the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the two are attached to ﴿رجومًا﴾.
﴿وأعتدنا﴾: the wāw conjoins to ﴿زينا﴾; «أعتدنا» is a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and «نا» is the fāʿil; the clause «أعتدنا» is conjoined to «زينا», with no grammatical position.
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعتدنا﴾.
﴿عذاب﴾: a mafʿūl bihi, in the accusative, and it is a muḍāf.
﴿السعير﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), made genitive by the kasra.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿وللذين﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya) or a conjunction; «للذين» is a fronted khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or conjoined to ﴿زينا﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿كفروا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿بربهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿كفروا﴾.
﴿عذاب﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), and it is a muḍāf.
﴿جهنم﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), made genitive by the fatḥa, because it is a diptote on account of being a proper name and feminine.
﴿وبئس﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and «بئس» is an inflexible (jāmid) verb for expressing blame.
﴿المصير﴾: the fāʿil, in the nominative (marfūʿ); the clause made up of the verb and the fāʿil is in the position of a nominative as the fronted khabar of an omitted postponed mubtadaʾ, which is the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm), its implied form being: «جهنم». The clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿إذا﴾: an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿سمعوا﴾; [it is] a muḍāf.
﴿ألقوا﴾: a past [verb] built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw of the plural is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause «ألقوا» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ألقوا﴾; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿سمعوا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «سمعوا» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿لها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿شهيقًا﴾.
﴿شهيقا﴾: the object of «سمعوا».
﴿وهي﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هي» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تفور﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil being latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هي» (it); the clause «تفور» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause «وهي تفور» is circumstantial, from the hāʾ in «لها».

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿تكاد﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), one of the verbs of approximation (afʿāl al-muqāraba); its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هي» (it). The clause «تكاد» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «تفور», or a second khabar (predicate) of the pronoun «هي» in His saying «وهي تفور», or resumptive by way of explanation (istiʾnāf bayānī), with no grammatical position, as if it came as the answer to a questioner's question.
﴿تميز﴾: an imperfect [verb] in the nominative, its fāʿil (agent) being a latent pronoun, its implied form being «هي»; the clause ﴿تميز﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the khabar of «تكاد».
﴿من الغيظ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted tamyīz (specification), i.e.: «غيظًا» (in rage).
﴿كلما﴾: ﴿كلَّ﴾ stands in for an adverb of time, attached to ﴿سألهم﴾ and containing the meaning of condition; ﴿ما﴾ is temporal maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya zamāniyya); the clause ﴿أُلقيَ﴾ has no grammatical position because it is the ṣila of the particle-relative ﴿ما﴾; and ﴿ما﴾ with what it governs is to be interpreted as a maṣdar, made genitive by annexation, the implied form being: «كلَّ إلقاءِ» (every casting), the expression being on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: «كلَّ وقتِ إلقاءِ فوجٍ فيها» (every time of the casting of a group into it). Or ﴿ما﴾ is a described indefinite (nakira mawṣūfa) in the sense of ﴿وقت﴾ (time), the referring pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, the implied form being: «كلَّ وقتٍ أُلقيَ فيه فوج في النار» (every time in which a group is cast into the Fire); the clause ﴿أُلقيَ﴾ is then in the position of a genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ما﴾.
﴿ألقي﴾: a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa.
﴿فيها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ألقي﴾.
﴿فوج﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿سألهم﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, and «هم» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «سألهم» has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿خزنتها﴾: the fāʿil of «سألهم», in the nominative.
﴿ألم﴾: the hamza is for interrogation of affirmation and rebuke (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī al-tawbīkhī), a particle indeclinable on fatḥa with no grammatical position; «لم» is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يأتكم﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the kāf is a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿نذير﴾: the fāʿil, in the nominative; the interrogative clause is the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿سأل﴾.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿قالوا﴾: «قال» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿بلى﴾: a particle of answer, indeclinable on sukūn, with no grammatical position, for cancelling the negation in His saying: ﴿ألم يأتكم﴾.
﴿قد﴾: a particle of verification (taḥqīq), indeclinable on sukūn, with no grammatical position.
﴿جاءنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa, and «نا» is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿نذير﴾: a postponed fāʿil, in the nominative (marfūʿ); the clause ﴿بلى قد جاءنا نذير﴾ is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); and the clause ﴿قالوا...﴾ is resumptive by way of explanation (istiʾnāf bayānī), with no grammatical position, as if it were said: What did they say? ﴿فكذبنا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «كذبنا» is a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and «نا» is the fāʿil; the clause «كذبنا» is conjoined to the maqūl al-qawl, in the position of an accusative.
﴿وقلنا﴾: the wāw conjoins to «كذبنا»; «قلنا» is a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and «نا» is the fāʿil.
﴿ما﴾: negating.
﴿نزل﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on fatḥa.
﴿الله﴾: the fāʿil, in the nominative.
﴿من﴾: a redundant (ṣila) preposition.
﴿شيء﴾: genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative as a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as the maqūl al-qawl.
﴿إن﴾: «إن» is negating, indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿أنتم﴾: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr), indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿في ضلال﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of «أنتم».
﴿كبير﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of «ضلال», in the genitive; the clause is part of the completion of the maqūl al-qawl; or it is the object of an omitted saying, from the messengers' words to them; or it is part of the completion of the keepers' saying: «ألم يأتكم نذير؟ إن أنتم إلا في ضلال مبين» «[Translator's note: so in the source; the verse reads «في ضلال كبير».]», the group's answer having come between the two.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وقالوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قالوا» is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause «قالوا» is conjoined to the preceding «قالوا», with no grammatical position.
﴿لو﴾: conditional, indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿كنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and «نا» is its noun.
﴿نسمع﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil being a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «نحن» (we); the clause «نسمع» is the khabar (predicate) of «كنا».
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction, indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿نعقل﴾: an imperfect [verb] in the nominative, its fāʿil being a latent pronoun; the clause «نعقل» is conjoined to «نسمع», in the position of an accusative (manṣūb).
﴿ما﴾: negating, indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿كنا﴾: a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn, and «نا» is its noun.
﴿في﴾: a preposition, indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿أصحاب﴾: made genitive (majrūr) by the kasra; a muḍāf.
﴿السعير﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the genitive; the clause «في أصحاب السعير» is the khabar of «كنا»; the clause «ما كنا في أصحاب السعير» is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position; and the clause of the condition with its apodosis is in the position of an accusative as the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿فاعترفوا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; ﴿اعترفوا﴾ is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿اعترفوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿وقالوا﴾; or the fāʾ is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); on either view the clause has no grammatical position. Or the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), the clause being conjoined to an omitted [clause], i.e.: «إذ قالوا ذلك فقد اعترفوا» (since they said that, they have confessed).
﴿بذنبهم﴾: the bāʾ is a preposition, «ذنب» is genitive (majrūr) and a muḍāf, and the pronoun is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اعترفوا﴾.
﴿فسحقا﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive or a conjunction; «سحقًا» is made accusative (manṣūb) by an omitted verb, i.e.: «ألزمهم الله سحقًا» (Allah made remoteness binding on them); or it is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: «سحقهم الله سحقًا» (Allah removed them far away), the maṣdar standing in for its governing word (ʿāmil) in supplication.
﴿لأصحاب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the maṣdar; «أصحاب» is a muḍāf.
﴿السعير﴾: a muḍāf ilayhi, made genitive by the kasra; the clause ﴿فسحقا لأصحاب السعير﴾ is resumptive, or conjoined to the clause «اعترفوا»; on either view the clause has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿إن﴾: an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh).
﴿الذين﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the noun of «إن».
﴿يخشون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), its fāʿil (agent) being a pronoun whose implied form is «هم» (they); the clause «يخشون» is the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين», with no grammatical position.
﴿ربهم﴾: the word «رب» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), made accusative by the fatḥa, a muḍāf, and «هم» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿بالغيب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «يخشون».
﴿لهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿مغفرة﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿وأجر﴾: conjoined to «مغفرة».
﴿كبير﴾: a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أجر﴾, in the nominative; the nominal clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar of «إن».

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وأسروا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «أسروا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿قولكم﴾: «قول» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object), a muḍāf, and «كم» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction, indeclinable on sukūn, and given a kasra because of the sukūn of what follows it.
﴿اجهروا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اجهروا﴾.
﴿إنه﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the pronoun is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as its noun.
﴿عليم﴾: the khabar (predicate) of «إن».
﴿بذات﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿عليم﴾.
﴿الصدرو﴾ «[Translator's note: so spelled in the source, for ﴿الصدور﴾.]»: a muḍāf ilayhi, in the genitive (majrūr); the clause ﴿إنه عليم بذات الصدور﴾ is resumptive by way of explanation (istiʾnāf bayānī), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ألا﴾: the hamza is for interrogation, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, with no grammatical position, and «لا» is negating, indeclinable on sukūn.
﴿يعلم﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being «هو» (He), referring back to Allah the Exalted; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿من﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); or «مَن» is the fāʿil of «يعلم», and the object of «يعلم» is omitted.
﴿خلق﴾: a past verb whose fāʿil is a latent pronoun referring back to the fāʿil of «يعلم», and whose object is omitted, referring back to «من»; when «مَن» is parsed as the fāʿil, the fāʿil of «خلق» refers back to «من» and its object refers back to the object of «يعلم». The clause «خلق» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وهو﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and «هو» is a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿اللطيف﴾: a first khabar (predicate).
﴿الخبير﴾: a second khabar; the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿هو﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذي﴾: the khabar (predicate).
﴿جعل﴾: a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, its fāʿil (agent) being a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause «جعل» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ذلولا﴾; it has also been said: attached to ﴿جعل﴾.
﴿الأرض﴾: the object of «جعل».
﴿ذلولا﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) if «جعل» is in the sense of «خلق» (created), or the second object of «جعل» if it is in the sense of «صير» (made into).
﴿فامشوا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), i.e.: if you have come to know that, then walk; «امشوا» is an imperative verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause «امشوا» is conjoined to an omitted [clause], and the omitted [clause] is a resumptive clause with no grammatical position.
﴿في مناكبها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿امشوا﴾.
﴿وكلوا﴾: an imperative verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿من رزقه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كلوا﴾.
﴿وإليه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. «إليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar.
﴿النشور﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿إليه النشور﴾ is conjoined to the clause of the ṣila, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿أأمنتم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disavowal (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and «أمنتم» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿من﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿في السماء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position.
﴿أن يخسف﴾: «أن» is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; «يخسف» is an imperfect verb in the accusative (manṣūb); the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (He); and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يخسف﴾ is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from ﴿مَن﴾, in the accusative.
﴿بكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخسف﴾.
﴿الأرض﴾: a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فإذا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya).
﴿هي﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿تمور﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the fāʿil being «هي» (it); the clause is in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of «هي».

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿أم﴾: a conjunction in the sense of «بل» (rather).
﴿أمنتم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿من﴾: a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿في السماء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun; the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position.
﴿أن يرسل﴾: «أن» together with what falls within its scope is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «من».
﴿عليكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرسل﴾.
﴿حاصبًا﴾: a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فستعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); the sīn is a particle of the future; and «تعلمون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn.
﴿كيف﴾: an interrogative noun, a fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿نذير﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the first-person yāʾ has been dropped in the script; and the suspended (muʿallaq) clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of «تعلمون».

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿ولقد﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya), and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; the lām prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); and «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq).
﴿كذب﴾: a past verb.
﴿الذين﴾: the fāʿil (agent).
﴿من قبلهم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted [verb that is the] ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position.
﴿فكيف﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction, and «كيف» is an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as the fronted khabar (predicate) of «كان».
﴿كان﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb.
﴿نكير﴾: its noun; the yāʾ has been dropped in conformity with the script of the Muṣḥaf, i.e.: «إنكاري عليهم» (My disapproval of them).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿أولم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disavowal (al-istifhām al-inkārī); the wāw conjoins to an implied [clause], i.e.: «أغفلوا» (were they heedless?); and «لم» is a particle of negation, of conversion [to the past] and of the jussive.
﴿يروا﴾: an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لم﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿إلى الطير﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يروا﴾.
﴿فوقهم﴾: an adverb attached to «صافات».
﴿صافات﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويقبضن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يقبضن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil.
﴿ما يمسكهن﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position; «ما» is negating; «يمسكهن» is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿الرحمن﴾: the fāʿil.
﴿إنه بكل شيء بصير﴾: «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the hāʾ is its noun; «بكل شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بصير﴾; «بصير» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; and the clause gives the reason (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿أمن﴾: «أم» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, in the sense of «بل» (rather), and «من» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, the khabar (predicate).
﴿الذي﴾: a badal (substitute) from «هذا», or an adjective (ṣifa) of the demonstrative.
﴿هو﴾: a mubtadaʾ.
﴿جند﴾: the khabar.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted naʿt (adjective) of «جند»; the clause ﴿هو جند لكم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿ينصركم﴾: a second naʿt, or a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿من دون﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينصركم﴾.
﴿الرحمن﴾: the word «الرحمن» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), in the genitive (majrūr).
﴿إن﴾: «إن» is negating.
﴿الكافرون﴾: a mubtadaʾ.
﴿إلا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿في غرور﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ. The clause ﴿إنِ الكافرون...﴾ is parenthetical or resumptive; on either view it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿أمن﴾: «أم» is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, in the sense of «بل» (rather), and «من» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿هذا﴾: a demonstrative, the khabar (predicate).
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun, a badal (substitute) from the demonstrative ﴿هذا﴾, or an adjective (ṣifa) of the demonstrative.
﴿يرزقكم﴾: an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the kāf is a pronoun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يرزقكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿أمسك﴾: a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb) is omitted, indicated by what precedes.
﴿رزقه﴾: a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بل﴾: a particle of digression (iḍrāb).
﴿لجوا﴾: a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil.
﴿في عتو﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿لجوا﴾.
﴿ونفور﴾: conjoined to «عتو».

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿أفمن﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of rebuke (tawbīkh); the fāʾ conjoins to an omitted, implied [clause]; and «من» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يمشي﴾: an imperfect verb, the fāʿil (agent) being latent (mustatir); the clause ﴿يمشي﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿مكبًّا﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of «يمشي».
﴿على وجهه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مكبًّا﴾.
﴿أهدى﴾: the khabar (predicate).
﴿أم﴾: a conjunction counterbalancing (muʿādil) the interrogative hamza.
﴿من﴾: conjoined to the first ﴿من﴾.
﴿يمشي﴾: an imperfect verb, the fāʿil being latent; the clause ﴿يمشي﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿سويًّا﴾: a ḥāl.
﴿على صراط﴾: [a preposition and its genitive noun,] attached to ﴿يمشي﴾.
﴿مستقيم﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), in the genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).
﴿هو﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذي﴾: the khabar (predicate).
﴿أنشأكم﴾: a past verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿أنشأكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The nominal clause is the object of the one saying (maqūl al-qāʾil).
﴿وجعل﴾: conjoined to ﴿أنشأكم﴾.
﴿لكم﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جعل﴾, or in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a mafʿūl bihi of ﴿جعلنا﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the verb in this verse is «جعل».]».
﴿السمع﴾: a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿والأبصار﴾: conjoined to «السمع».
﴿والأفئدة﴾: likewise conjoined.
﴿قليلا﴾: it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the omitted maṣdar, i.e.: «تشكرون شكرًا قليلًا» (you give little thanks).
﴿ما﴾: redundant (ṣila), to emphasise the littleness.
﴿تشكرون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its being nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿قليلا ما تشكرون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿قل﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).
﴿هو﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذي﴾: the khabar (predicate).
﴿ذرأكم﴾: a past verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿ذرأكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The nominal clause is the object of the one saying (maqūl al-qāʾil).
﴿في الأرض﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ذرأكم﴾.
﴿وإليه﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «إليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تحشرون﴾.
﴿تحشرون﴾: an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿ويقولون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «يقولون» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿متى﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as an adverb of time; the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate).
﴿هذا﴾: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الوعد﴾: a badal (substitute).
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿كنتم﴾: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «كان» is a defective past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun.
﴿صادقين﴾: its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, i.e.: if you are truthful in what you report about the matter of the Resurrection and the Gathering, then make its time clear precisely.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿قل﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir).
﴿إنما﴾: [«إنّ»] restrained [from governing] by the restraining [«ما»] (kāffa wa-makfūfa).
﴿العلم﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿عند الله﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ.
﴿وإنما﴾: conjoined to the first «إنما».
﴿أنا﴾: a mubtadaʾ.
﴿نذير﴾: the khabar.
﴿مبين﴾: a naʿt (adjective); the two clauses are the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying).

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿فلما﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), and «لما» is temporal (ḥīniyya), or a linking [particle] containing the meaning of condition.
﴿رأوه﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿زلفة﴾: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «رأوه», or an adverb, i.e.: «مكانًا ذا زلفة» (a place of nearness).
﴿سيئت﴾: a verb and its fāʿil «[Translator's note: so in the source; «سيئت» is passive and «وجوه» is its nāʾib fāʿil, as stated below.]»; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of «لما».
﴿وجوه﴾: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿الذين﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) relative noun, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿كفروا﴾: a verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «قيل» is a past verb built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), and the nāʾib fāʿil is latent (mustatir), i.e.: the keepers said to them.
﴿هذا﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as an adjective (ṣifa) of the omitted khabar (predicate), i.e.: «هذا العذاب الذي» (this is the punishment which).
﴿كنتم﴾: the clause ﴿كنتم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تدعون﴾.
﴿تدعون﴾: the clause «تدعون» is the khabar of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
﴿قل﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun.
﴿أرأيتم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disavowal (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and «رأيتم», in the sense of «أخبروني» (tell me), is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿أهلكني الله﴾: «أهلكني» is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the nūn is for protection (wiqāya); the yāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «الله» is the fāʿil. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: «فلا فائدة لكم، ولا نفع يعود عليكم» (then there is no gain for you, nor any benefit that comes back to you).
﴿ومن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and «من» is conjoined to the yāʾ.
﴿معي﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾; the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position.
﴿أو﴾: a conjunction.
﴿رحمنا﴾: a past verb, a latent fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi.
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is causal (taʿlīliyya); «من» is an interrogative noun whose meaning is negation, i.e.: no one; [it is] in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a fāʿil «[Translator's note: so in the source; the next line makes the clause «يجير» its khabar, which implies that «من» is a mubtadaʾ.]».
﴿يجير﴾: a verb, and the fāʿil is latent; the clause is the khabar (predicate).
﴿الكافرين﴾: an object.
﴿من عذاب﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجير﴾.
﴿أليم﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), in the genitive (majrūr).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿قل﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun.
﴿هو﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿الرحمن﴾: the khabar (predicate).
﴿آمنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a second khabar.
﴿به﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿آمنا﴾.
﴿وعليه﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿توكلنا﴾.
﴿توكلنا﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined to «آمنا به».
﴿فستعلمون﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition); the sīn is a particle of the future; and «تعلمون» is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿من﴾: an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative as a mubtadaʾ.
﴿هو﴾: a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).
﴿في ضلال﴾: the khabar of «من».
﴿مبين﴾: an adjective (ṣifa), in the genitive (majrūr); the interrogative clause stands in place of the two objects of «تعلمون», which is suspended (muʿallaq) [from governing] by the interrogative.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿قل﴾: an indeclinable (mabnī) imperative verb, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun.
﴿أرأيتم﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of disavowal (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and «رأيتم», in the sense of «أخبروني» (tell me), is a verb and its fāʿil.
﴿إن﴾: conditional.
﴿أصبح﴾: an abrogating (nāsikh) past verb.
﴿ماؤكم﴾: the noun of «أصبح».
﴿غورًا﴾: the khabar (predicate); the conditional clause stands in place of the two objects of «أرأيتم».
﴿فمن﴾: the fāʾ is linking, and «من» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject).
﴿يأتيكم﴾: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause made up of the verb and the fāʿil is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as the khabar, and the clause ﴿فمن يأتيكم بماء معين﴾ is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿بماء﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يأتيكم﴾.
﴿معين﴾: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿ماء﴾.

nahhas-irab:1-1.t: That is, He gives it to whom He wills and withholds it from whom He wills, and this omission is indicated by وَهُوَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.

nahhas-irab:2-2.t: الَّذِي خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَالْحَياةَ is in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute) from the first «الذي», or by an implied mubtadaʾ (subject); the accusative is also permissible in the sense of "I mean" (aʿnī). لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا: «أيّ» is nominative as a mubtadaʾ, and it is a complete noun, and أَحْسَنُ is its khabar (predicate). The implied form is: "that He may test you and see which of you is best in deed". وَهُوَ الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفُورُ: a mubtadaʾ and its khabar.

nahhas-irab:3-3.t: خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَماواتٍ: the same applies here as in the first; it may also be a khabar (predicate) after a khabar, or a naʿt (adjective) of «العزيز». طِباقاً: a naʿt of «سبع»; it may be the plural of «طبقة», like «رحبة» and «رحاب», or the plural of «طبق», like «جمل» and «جمال»; it may also be a maṣdar (verbal noun). مّا ترى في خلق الرّحمن من تفوت [Translator's note: the source text here is unvowelled and does not distinguish the two readings; the first is presumably «تفاوت» (تفاوت)] is the reading of the Medinans, Abū ʿAmr and ʿĀṣim; and the reading of Yaḥyā, al-Aʿmash, Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī is «من تفوّت» (تفوّت), and this is the choice of Abū ʿUbayd. Among the best things said about it is the view of al-Farrāʾ: that they are two dialect forms with one meaning. If a preference were permissible here, the first would be more fitting, because it is the well-known one in [speaking of] Allah [Translator's note: the text reads «في الله»; perhaps «في اللغة» "in the language" was intended]: one says «تفاوت الأمرُ», like «تباين», i.e. parts of it differed from others. So the creation of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, is neither disparate nor uneven, because all of it points to wisdom, not to idle play, and to a Maker of it. فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ: there is no "look" before it, but before it is what indicates it, namely ما تَرى فِي خَلْقِ الرَّحْمنِ مِنْ تَفاوُتٍ. هَلْ تَرى مِنْ فُطُورٍ is in the position of the accusative.

nahhas-irab:4-4.t: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ: in the sense of a maṣdar (verbal noun) or an adverb (ẓarf). ينقلب إليك البصر: the answer to the command. خاسِئاً: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate), in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl.

nahhas-irab:5-5.t: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّماءَ الدُّنْيا بِمَصابِيحَ: according to the usage of those who say «مصباح». وَجَعَلْناها رُجُوماً لِلشَّياطِينِ: «رجوما» may be the maṣdar (verbal noun) of «يرجم»; it may also be the plural of «راجم» (one who stones), according to the view of those who say the stars are what [the devils] are stoned with. The other view is according to those who say the stars do not leave their places, and [the devils] are stoned only with shooting flames (shuhub). وَأَعْتَدْنا لَهُمْ عَذابَ السَّعِيرِ: that is, in addition to that.

nahhas-irab:6-6.t: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذابُ جَهَنَّمَ: nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject). Hārūn reported from Usayd that he read وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذابُ جَهَنَّمَ [i.e. «عذابَ جهنم»], conjoining it to the first. [Translator's note: the vowelled text reproduces the standard reading, not the variant described.] وَبِئْسَ الْمَصِيرُ: nominative by «بئس» [Translator's note: the text has «ربع», a misprint for «رفع» "nominative"].

nahhas-irab:7-8.t: إِذا أُلْقُوا فِيها سَمِعُوا لَها شَهِيقاً: that is, a sound like braying. تَكادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ: the origin is «تتميّز». Al-Farrāʾ said: that is, it is torn apart. كُلَّما أُلْقِيَ فِيها فَوْجٌ: accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), in the sense of «إذا» (when). سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُها أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ: that is, they said to them.

nahhas-irab:9-9.t: نَذِيرٌ: in the sense of «منذر» (warner). إِنْ أَنْتُمْ إِلَّا فِي ضَلالٍ كَبِيرٍ: «إن» in the sense of «ما» (not).

nahhas-irab:10-10.t: There are two views about it. One of them: "if we had accepted", just as one says «سمع الله لمن حمده» (Allah hears whoever praises Him), i.e. accepts; «أو نعقل», i.e. reflect and see clearly. The other view is that when they heard, they did not benefit from what they heard, so they were like the deaf. [Translator's note: the text reads «لو كان نقبل»; probably «لو كنا نقبل» "if we had accepted" was intended.]

nahhas-irab:11-11.t: فَاعْتَرَفُوا بِذَنْبِهِمْ: He did not say «بذنوبهم» (their sins), because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) conveying the genus. فَسُحْقاً لِأَصْحابِ السَّعِيرِ.

nahhas-irab:12-12.t: Among the best things said about it is that the meaning is: those who fear their Lord when they are absent from people's eyes — because that is the time when sins abound; so if they fear their Lord, Mighty and Majestic, when people are absent from them, and avoid sins, they will avoid them even more in the presence of people. لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ: the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».

nahhas-irab:13-13.t: وَأَسِرُّوا قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ اجْهَرُوا بِهِ: the wāw [of "aw"] was given kasra because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, and kasra was chosen for it because it is a radical (aṣliyya). إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ بِذاتِ الصُّدُورِ: that is, of their reality.

nahhas-irab:14-14.t: أَلا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ: Abū Jaʿfar said: someone weak in Arabic may imagine that «من» is in the position of the accusative; but if its position were accusative, it would be «ألا يعلم ما خلق», because it refers back to بِذاتِ الصُّدُورِ. The implied form is rather: "does not He who created them know their secret and their open aspect?" وَهُوَ اللَّطِيفُ الْخَبِيرُ: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate).

nahhas-irab:15-16.t:
And likewise هُوَ الَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا: that is, easy for you to walk on. One says «ذلول», clearly tractable (bayyinatu al-dhill), and «ذليل», clearly abased (bayyinu al-dhull). فَامْشُوا فِي مَناكِبِها: the plural of «منكب», which is a side or region. وَكُلُوا مِنْ رِزْقِهِ: [something] has been dropped from it; if it followed the analogy of its counterparts, «أُكُلوا» would be said, just as you say «أُجِرُوا». وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ: nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject).
أَأَمِنْتُمْ مَنْ فِي السَّماءِ: al-Farrāʾ reported that it is the dialect of Banū Tamīm to add an alif between the two alifs.
Abū Jaʿfar said: he means they add an alif so as not to bring two hamzas together, saying «أأأمنتم من في السماء». أَنْ يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْأَرْضَ: in the position of the accusative as an object. فَإِذا هِيَ تَمُورُ: in the position of the nominative; the accusative is also permissible, i.e. «فإذا هي مائرةً» (and behold, it is quaking).

nahhas-irab:17-18.t: That is, dust and pebbles; and it may be the cloud containing hail and thunderbolts. فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ: in the position of the nominative, because the interrogative is not governed by what precedes it. The yāʾ was dropped because it is the end of a verse, and likewise وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كانَ نَكِيرِ (18).

nahhas-irab:19-19.t: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صافَّاتٍ: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). وَيَقْبِضْنَ: conjoined to it; it may also be given a fresh start, cut off from it. ما يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا الرَّحْمنُ: because He, Mighty and Majestic, created the air, so they hold themselves up in it. إِنَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ بَصِيرٌ: the khabar (predicate) of «إنّ».

nahhas-irab:20-20.t: That is, who would repel from you [harm] if He intended evil for you. إِنِ الْكافِرُونَ إِلَّا فِي غُرُورٍ: that is, the disbelievers, in their supposition — i.e. that their worship of other than Allah, Mighty and Majestic, benefits them — are in nothing but delusion.

nahhas-irab:21-21.t: أَمَّنْ هذَا الَّذِي يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُ: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, because the first part indicates it, i.e. "if He withholds His provision, will those you worship besides Him provide for you?" بَلْ لَجُّوا فِي عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ: the origin is «لجّوا», then it was assimilated.

nahhas-irab:22-22.t: "Man" is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «أهدى» is its khabar (predicate). أَمَّنْ يَمْشِي سَوِيًّا عَلى صِراطٍ مُسْتَقِيمٍ: conjoined to it.

nahhas-irab:23-23.t:
قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي أَنْشَأَكُمْ: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate). وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْأَبْصارَ وَالْأَفْئِدَةَ: He did not say
«الأسماع» (hearings), because «السمع» is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun).

nahhas-irab:24-24.t: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي الْأَرْضِ: like the first.

nahhas-irab:25-25.t: مَتى is in the position of the nominative, because it is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هذَا, according to the view of Sībawayh; according to the view of others it is in the position of the accusative, because [for them] «هذا» is not nominative as a mubtadaʾ. Abū al-ʿAbbās [al-Mubarrad] puts it in the nominative in the sense of "when will this promise come to pass?"

nahhas-irab:26-26.t: قُلْ إِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ: you put «العلم» in the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject); according to Sībawayh, the accusative is not permissible by making «ما» redundant (zāʾida). Likewise وَإِنَّما أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ.

nahhas-irab:27-27.t: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً: the hāʾ may refer back to the promise. سِيئَتْ ] وُجُوهُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا وَقِيلَ هذَا الَّذِي كُنْتُمْ بِهِ تَدَّعُونَ: the soundest thing said about it is that it is «تفتعلون» from «دعاء» (calling), then assimilated. Abū ʿUbayd said: «تدّعون» is derived from «يدعون».

nahhas-irab:28-28.t: أَرَأَيْتُمْ: if you lighten the hamza of «أرأيتم», you pronounce it between-between (bayna bayna), and the yāʾ remains quiescent as it is. فَمَنْ يُجِيرُ الْكافِرِينَ مِنْ عَذابٍ أَلِيمٍ: «من» is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and it is a complete noun.

nahhas-irab:29-29.t: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمنُ آمَنَّا بِهِ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنا: that is, your Creator and Provider and the doer of these things is the Most Merciful. فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ضَلالٍ مُبِينٍ: «من» is in the position of the nominative as a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is its khabar (predicate), because it is an interrogative, and what precedes does not govern an interrogative. It may also be in the position of the accusative, in the sense of «الذي» (the one who).

nahhas-irab:30-30.t:
قُلْ أَرَأَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ ماؤُكُمْ غَوْراً: al-Farrāʾ said: «غور» is not put in the dual or plural, because it is a maṣdar (verbal noun), like
«رضا» and «عدل»; so one says «ماءان غورٌ» (two waters sunk away). Abū Jaʿfar said: its rule is that it is not put in the dual or plural; but if you mean different kinds, you put it in the dual and plural. The implied form is "if your water became possessed of sinking", like وَسْئَلِ الْقَرْيَةَ [Yūsuf: 82]. It has been said: «غور» in the sense of «غائر» (sinking). فَمَنْ يَأْتِيكُمْ بِماءٍ مَعِينٍ: it may be of the pattern faʿīl from «معن الماء», when the water is abundant; it may also be of the pattern mafʿūl, its origin being «معيون», like «مبيع»; on this its meaning is water that is seen with the eyes.

safi-cedvel:1-4.t:
* I'rab:
(بيده) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) of the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) (الملك); (الواو) conjunction; (على كلّ) attached to the khabar (قدير).
The clause «تبارك الذي ...» has no grammatical position: initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «بيده الملك ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «هو ... قدير» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the ṣila clause.
2- (الذي) in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) of the first relative, the fāʿil (agent) of تبارك; (الواو) conjunction in both places; (اللام) of purpose (taʿlīl); (يبلوكم) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām; (أيّكم) an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), and (كم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (عملا) tamyīz (specification), accusative.
The clause «خلق ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the second relative (الذي).
The clause «يبلوكم ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the implied particle relative (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يبلوكم ...) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (خلق).
The clause «أيّكم أحسن ...» is in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), its governor being يبلوكم, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative أيّكم.
The clause «هو العزيز ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause [Note: The clause may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil of خلق.].
3- (الذي) in the position of nominative as a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ هو [Note: Or a naʿt (adjective) of الغفور, or a badal of it, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it ...]; (طباقا) a naʿt of سبع, accusative [Note: Or it is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, being a maṣdar, i.e. طابقت طباقا.]; (ما) negative; (في خلق) attached to a ḥāl of تفاوت; (تفاوت) genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi of the verb of seeing; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (هل) an interrogative particle; (فطور) genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi ...
The clause «خلق» (the second) has no grammatical position: ṣila of the third relative (الذي).
The clause «ما ترى ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: Or a second naʿt of سبع, with the linking pronoun implied, i.e. of disparity in them.].
The clause «ارجع البصر ...» is in the position of jussive as apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if you want to see for yourself, then turn back ...
The clause «هل ترى من فطور ...» is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi of an implied verb suspended by the interrogative, i.e. turn back your sight and look: do you see ...
4- (ثمّ) a conjunction; (كرّتين) a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, for it is its number; (ينقلب) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), for it is the response to the command; (إليك) attached to (ينقلب); (خاسئا) an accusative ḥāl of البصر; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
The clause «ارجع البصر ...» is conjoined to the clause ارجع البصر (the first).
The clause «ينقلب إليك البصر ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of an implied condition, not joined with fāʾ.
The clause «هو حسير ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of البصر or of the pronoun in (خاسئا); it is then nested (mutadākhila) with the first ḥāl.

* Morphology:
(طباقا): plural of طبقة, with fatḥa then sukūn, or plural of طبق, with two fatḥas, and it is a noun in both cases; or it is a maṣdar known by hearing (samāʿī) of the quadriliteral طابق, whose regular form is مطابقة; it may also be an intensive description. The pattern of طباق is فعال with kasra on the fāʾ.
(ترى): the rule of its inflection is like the verb نرى ... see verse (5) of Sūrat al-Baqara.
(تفاوت): a regular maṣdar of the five-letter verb تفاوت, meaning "to differ". Its pattern is تفاعل with fatḥa on the tāʾ and ḍamma on the ʿayn.
(فطور): plural of فطر, with kasra then sukūn, which is a split or crack. In al-Mukhtār: الفطر is splitting; one says فطره فانفطر, and تفطّر الشيء means the thing cracked; its conjugation class is that of نصر.
(حسير): a ṣifa mushabbaha (assimilated adjective) resembling the active participle, from the triliteral حسر, of the class of ضرب, i.e. it became weary and its sight failed. Its pattern is فعيل.

safi-cedvel:5-5.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of realisation (ḥarf taḥqīq); (بمصابيح) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (زيّنا), and (الباء) is instrumental (li-l-istiʿāna); (للشياطين) attached to (رجوما) [Note: On the view that it is a maṣdar ... or attached to a naʿt (adjective) of (رجوما).]; (الواو) conjunction; (لهم) attached to (أعتدنا).
The clause «زيّنا ...» has no grammatical position: response to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause is resumptive.
The clause «جعلناها ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the response to the oath.
The clause «أعتدنا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause جعلناها [Note: The clause may be a ḥāl (circumstantial) with قد implied.].

* Morphology:
(رجوما): the maṣdar of the triliteral رجم, used as a description in the sense of the passive participle, i.e. that with which one is pelted; it may also be used as a maṣdar after the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. ذات رجوم "possessing pelting". The maṣdar is pluralised in consideration of its kinds. Its pattern is فعول with ḍamma on the fāʾ. Or it is the plural of رجم, a noun for what one pelts with, on the pattern فعل with fatḥa then sukūn.

* Rhetoric:
Explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya): in His words وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا السَّماءَ الدُّنْيا بِمَصابِيحَ.
The planets and stars are likened to lamps; the thing likened is omitted and the thing it is likened to is retained, by way of primary explicit metaphor. That is because people adorn their mosques and houses with lit lamps, but these are lamps that do not equal them, i.e. lamps of illumination.

safi-cedvel:6-8.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (للذين) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (عذاب); (بربّهم) attached to (كفروا); (الواو) resumptive — or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) — and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bi-l-dhamm) is omitted, its implied form being "هي", i.e. Hell.
The clause «للذين كفروا ... عذاب» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «بئس المصير ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive [Note: Or in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of جهنّم, the governing factor in it being ibtidāʾ (inception as subject).].
7- (الواو) in (ألقوا) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (فيها) attached to (ألقوا); (لها) attached to a ḥāl of (شهيقا); (الواو) circumstantial ...
The clause «ألقوا ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «سمعوا ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. The clause «هي تفور ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the pronoun in (لها).
8- (من الغيظ) attached to (تميّز) [Note: And (من) is causal ... or it is a tamyīz (specification), i.e. it almost bursts with rage ... or attached to a ḥāl of the agent pronoun in (تميّز).]; (كلّما) an adverb in the sense of "when", containing the meaning of condition, in the position of accusative, attached to the apodosis سألهم; (فيها) attached to (ألقي); (الهمزة) for reproachful interrogation ...
The clause «تكاد تميّز ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of تفور.
The clause «تميّز ...» is in the position of accusative as khabar of تكاد.
The clause «الشرط وفعله وجوابه ...» (the condition, its protasis and its apodosis) has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «ألقي فيها فوج ...» is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «سألهم خزنتها ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «لم يأتكم نذير ...» is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) — and it is restricted by the preposition — of the verb سأل, which is suspended from governing by the interrogative, i.e. they asked them about the coming of the warner to them.

* Morphology:
(يأتكم): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion on account of the jussive. Its pattern is يفعكم.

* Rhetoric:
Explicit metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-taṣrīḥiyya): in His words «تَكادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ الْغَيْظِ».
The blazing of the fire upon them — in the strength of its effect on them and its bringing harm to them — is likened to the rage of an enraged person against another, going to the utmost in bringing harm to him, by way of explicit metaphor. It may also be here an imaginative metaphor (takhyīliyya) consequent upon an implicit metaphor (makniyya): Hell — in the intensity of its boiling and the strength of its effect on its people — is likened to a person intensely enraged against another, going to the utmost in bringing harm to him; then an image is imagined for it like the image of the real, felt state, namely the anger that prompts that, and [the word] rage was borrowed for that imagined state.
9-

safi-cedvel:9-11.t:
* I'rab:
(بلى) a particle of answer, affirming the negated question; (قد) a particle of realisation (ḥarf taḥqīq); (الفاء) conjunction, and likewise (الواو); (ما) negative; (شيء) genitive in form, accusative in position, as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (إن) a particle of negation; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (في ضلال) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (أنتم).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «قد جاءنا نذير ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «كذّبنا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the object-of-speech clause.
The clause «قلنا ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the object-of-speech clause.
The clause «ما نزّل الله ...» is in the position of accusative as the second object of speech.
The clause «إن أنتم إلّا في ضلال ...» has no grammatical position: a resumption within the scope of the second saying [Note: If it is part of the speech of the disbelievers ... and it is parenthetical if it is part of the speech of the angels ...].
10- (الواو) conjunction; (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle; (أو) a conjunction; (ما) negative; (في أصحاب) attached to the khabar of (كنّا).
The clause «قالوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause قالوا (the first).
The clause «لو كنّا نسمع ...» is in the position of accusative as the object of speech.
The clause «نسمع ...» is in the position of accusative as khabar of كنّا.
The clause «نعقل ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause نسمع. The clause «ما كنّا ...» has no grammatical position: apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition [Note: The meaning of the condition: if they are not among the companions of the Blaze then they are among the companions of Paradise; and their being so has been precluded because of the preclusion of their being hearers or reasoners.].
11- (الفاء) resumptive in both places; (بذنبهم) attached to (اعترفوا); (سحقا) a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb [Note: Or a mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, i.e. Allah has made remoteness binding upon them.]; (لأصحاب) attached to (سحقا) ... [Note: Or it is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being: the imprecation is for the companions of the Blaze.].
The clause «اعترفوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «(أسحقهم الله) سحقا» has no grammatical position: resumptive.

* Morphology:
(سحقا): the maṣdar of the triliteral سحق, meaning "to be remote", of the class of فرح and the class of كرم. Its pattern is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn.
12-

safi-cedvel:12-12.t:
* I'rab:
(بالغيب) attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of يخشون; (لهم) attached to a fronted khabar (predicate) of the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) (مغفرة) ...
The clause «إنّ الذين يخشون ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يخشون ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذين).
The clause «لهم مغفرة ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar of إنّ.
13- 14

safi-cedvel:13-14.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (أو) a conjunction; (به) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اجهروا); (بذات) attached to the khabar (predicate) (عليم).
The clause «أسرّوا ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «اجهروا به ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause أسرّوا.
The clause «إنّه عليم ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
14- (ألا) [the hamza is] a disapproving interrogative (istifhām inkārī), and [لا is] negation; (من) a relative in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent) of (يعلم) [Note: Or in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), with the fāʿil latent (mustatir), referring to Allah, and the referent pronoun of the third person omitted.]; (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) ...
The clause «يعلم من خلق ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «خلق ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (من).
The clause «هو اللطيف ...» is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).
15-

safi-cedvel:15-15.t:
* I'rab:
(لكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ذلولا), the second object; (الفاء) a conjunction linking the effect to the cause; (في مناكبها) attached to (امشوا); (الواو) conjunction in both places; (من رزقه) attached to (كلوا); (إليه) attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (النشور).
The clause «هو الذي ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «جعل ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila (relative clause) of the relative (الذي).
The clause «امشوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: take heed of this, so walk.
The clause «كلوا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the clause امشوا.
The clause «إليه النشور ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the ṣila clause.

* Morphology:
(امشوا): it contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion, as in (يمشون), because it is taken from it ... see verse (195) of al-Aʿrāf.
(مناكبها): plural of منكب, a noun meaning "side". Its pattern is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and kasra on the ʿayn, and the pattern of مناكب is مفاعل.
16- 17

safi-cedvel:16-17.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for threatening interrogation; (في السماء) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of من; (أن) an infinitival and subjunctive-governing particle; (بكم) attached to (يخسف); (الفاء) conjunction [Note: According to some, among them al-Fārisī and al-Māzinī, it is a necessary redundant (zāʾida) fāʾ.]; (إذا) a particle of surprise (fujāʾa).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخسف ...) is in the position of accusative as a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) of the relative (من).
The clause «أمنتم ...» has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يخسف ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The clause «هي تمور ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the resumptive clause.
The clause «هي تمور» has no grammatical position: conjoined to the resumptive clause.
The clause «تمور ...» is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) هي.
17- (أم) is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) one, in the sense of بل and the hamza; (من في السماء أن يرسل ...) is like من في السماء أن يخسف; (الفاء) linking the apodosis of an implied condition; (كيف) an interrogative noun in the position of nominative as a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (نذيري) ... which is nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, which was deleted to suit the verse-ending (fāṣila).
The clause «أمنتم» (the second) has no grammatical position: resumptive.
The clause «يرسل ...» has no grammatical position: ṣila of the particle relative (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يرسل) is in the position of accusative as a badal ishtimāl of the second relative (من).
The clause «ستعلمون ...» is in the position of jussive as apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of an implied condition, i.e.: if the punishment comes to you, you will know the state of My warning of it.
The clause «كيف نذير ...» is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb of knowing, which is suspended (muʿallaq) by the interrogative كيف.
18-

safi-cedvel:18-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive; (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath; (قد) a particle of realisation (ḥarf taḥqīq); (من قبلهم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; (الفاء) conjunction; (كيف) an interrogative noun in the position of accusative as khabar (predicate) of كان; (نكير) the noun of كان, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the letter before the yāʾ, which was deleted for the verse-ending (fāṣila), and the deleted (الياء) is muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «كذّب الذين ...» has no grammatical position: response to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause is resumptive.
The clause «كان نكير» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: so He punished them, and how was My disapproval!
19-

safi-cedvel:19-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) for rebuking interrogation; (إلى الطير) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يروا), in the sense of ينظروا "look"; (فوقهم) an adverb of place, accusative, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الطير [Note: Or attached to صافّات.]; (صافّات) a second ḥāl, accusative; (الواو) conjunction; (ما) negative; (إلّا) for restriction (ḥaṣr); (بكلّ) attached to the khabar (predicate) (بصير).
The clause «لم يروا ...» has no grammatical position: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to an implied resumptive clause, i.e.: have they been heedless and not seen. The clause «يقبضن ...» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the single-word ḥāl صافّات.
The clause «ما يمسكهنّ إلّا الرحمن ...» has no grammatical position: an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: al-ʿUkbarī said: it may be a ḥāl of the pronoun in (يقبضن), i.e. not held up except by the Most Merciful.].
The clause «إنّه ... بصير» has no grammatical position: causal (taʿlīliyya).

* Rhetoric:
Conjoining a verb to a noun: in His words «أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا إِلَى الطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صافَّاتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ».
He said ويقبضن, whereas the flow of the context would be to say وقابضات. That is because the basis of flying is spreading the wings, since flying in the air is like swimming in water, and the basis of swimming is stretching and extending the limbs. As for folding, it is incidental upon spreading, to help with it in moving. So what is incidental and not basic was brought in the form of the verb, meaning that they are spreading their wings, and folding occurs from them at times, just as it occurs from the swimmer. Spreading was expressed by the noun because it is predominant, and folding was expressed by the verb because it is incidental.
20-

safi-cedvel:20-20.t:
